modules.title: Inclusive Leadership in North America
modules.description: Develop leadership skills tailored to North America's diverse, multicultural workforce. Covers psychological safety, allyship, and equitable team management.
learningObjectives: Identify key dimensions of inclusive leadership in North American contexts
Apply frameworks for building psychologically safe teams
Develop personal allyship action plans
Navigate cross-cultural communication in US, Canadian, and Mexican work environments

modules.title: US Employment Law & HR Compliance
modules.description: Essential compliance training covering EEOC regulations, ADA, FMLA, Title VII, and state-specific labor laws for US-based employees and managers.
learningObjectives: Understand federal and state employment laws
Recognize and prevent workplace discrimination and harassment
Navigate accommodation requests under ADA
Manage FMLA leave appropriately
modules.audience: All US employees; required for managers

modules.title: Canadian Workplace Human Rights
modules.description: Compliance training aligned with Canadian Human Rights Act, provincial human rights codes, and AODA (Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act).
learningObjectives: Understand the Canadian Human Rights Act and provincial codes
Identify protected grounds of discrimination
Fulfill duty-to-accommodate obligations
Report and respond to harassment incidents

modules.title: Agile & Scrum Practitioner
modules.description: Comprehensive Agile methodology training covering Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe frameworks widely adopted across North American tech and enterprise sectors.
learningObjectives: Apply Scrum ceremonies and roles effectively
Build and manage product backlogs
Run effective sprint planning and retrospectives
Scale Agile using SAFe principles

modules.title: Data Privacy & CCPA Compliance
modules.description: Data privacy training covering the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), PIPEDA for Canadian operations, and best practices for protecting customer data.
learningObjectives: Understand CCPA consumer rights and business obligations
Implement data minimization and purpose limitation principles
Handle data subject requests appropriately
Apply PIPEDA requirements for Canadian operations

modules.title: Unconscious Bias in the Workplace
modules.description: Awareness and action-oriented training on recognizing and mitigating unconscious bias in hiring, performance reviews, and daily interactions.
learningObjectives: Define and identify common types of unconscious bias
Understand the impact of bias on organizational outcomes
Apply de-biasing strategies in decision-making
Create more equitable workplace practices

modules.title: Executive Presence & Communication
modules.description: Build the gravitas, communication skills, and influence strategies needed to lead at senior levels in North American corporate environments.
learningObjectives: Project confidence and credibility in high-stakes situations
Deliver compelling presentations to C-suite audiences
Navigate difficult conversations with senior stakeholders
Build and manage professional reputation

modules.title: Mental Health First Aid at Work
modules.description: Equip employees and managers with the skills to recognize mental health challenges and provide initial support in the workplace.
learningObjectives: Recognize signs of common mental health conditions
Apply the ALGEE action plan for mental health first aid
Reduce stigma around mental health in the workplace
Connect colleagues with appropriate support resources
modules.audience: All employees; especially beneficial for managers

modules.title: Financial Literacy for Employees
modules.description: Practical financial wellness training covering budgeting, retirement planning (401k/RRSP), employee benefits, and investment basics.
learningObjectives: Build and maintain a personal budget
Maximize employer retirement contribution benefits
Understand key employee benefits and coverage
Make informed basic investment decisions

modules.title: Customer Experience Excellence
modules.description: Develop skills to deliver world-class customer experiences aligned with North American consumer expectations and service standards.
learningObjectives: Map and optimize the end-to-end customer journey
Apply empathy-based service techniques
Handle difficult customer situations professionally
Use NPS and CSAT data to drive improvements

modules.title: Cybersecurity Awareness
modules.description: Essential cybersecurity training covering phishing, social engineering, password hygiene, and data protection best practices.
learningObjectives: Identify phishing and social engineering attempts
Apply strong password and MFA practices
Handle sensitive data securely
Report security incidents promptly

modules.title: Innovation & Design Thinking
modules.description: Hands-on training in Design Thinking methodology to solve complex problems and drive innovation across North American organizations.
learningObjectives: Apply the five stages of Design Thinking
Conduct empathy interviews and user research
Facilitate ideation and prototyping sessions
Test and iterate solutions with real users

modules.title: Spanish Language Essentials for Business
modules.description: Business Spanish for professionals working with Latin American colleagues and clients, with focus on Mexican business culture and etiquette.
learningObjectives: Conduct basic business conversations in Spanish
Understand Mexican and Latin American business etiquette
Navigate cultural nuances in cross-border business
Build relationships with Spanish-speaking stakeholders
modules.audience: US and Canadian employees with Latin American business exposure

modules.title: Negotiation Skills Mastery
modules.description: Advanced negotiation strategies and tactics for complex business deals in North American markets.
learningObjectives: Apply principled negotiation frameworks (Harvard Method)
Prepare and execute multi-party negotiations
Read and respond to negotiation tactics
Close deals while preserving long-term relationships
modules.audience: Sales, procurement, and senior business professionals

modules.title: Workplace Safety & OSHA Compliance
modules.description: OSHA-aligned workplace safety training for US operations, covering hazard identification, incident reporting, and emergency procedures.
learningObjectives: Identify workplace hazards and risk factors
Apply OSHA standards relevant to your industry
Complete incident and near-miss reports
Execute emergency response procedures
modules.audience: All US employees, mandatory for operations roles

modules.title: Leading Remote & Hybrid Teams
modules.description: Practical strategies for managing distributed teams effectively across time zones and work environments.
learningObjectives: Set clear expectations and accountability structures for remote teams
Use digital collaboration tools to maintain team cohesion
Conduct effective virtual meetings and one-on-ones
Maintain team culture and engagement in hybrid environments
modules.audience: Managers and team leads with remote reports

modules.title: Indigenous Cultural Awareness (Canada)
modules.description: Foundational learning on Indigenous history, cultures, and reconciliation in Canada, supporting Truth and Reconciliation commitments in the workplace.
learningObjectives: Understand key events of Canada's Indigenous history and their ongoing impact
Recognize the diversity of Indigenous Nations and cultures
Apply principles of reconciliation in daily work
Engage respectfully with Indigenous colleagues and communities

modules.title: Sustainability & ESG Fundamentals
modules.description: Introduction to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles and how employees contribute to corporate sustainability goals.
learningObjectives: Understand the ESG framework and its business importance
Identify individual contributions to sustainability goals
Apply circular economy thinking in operations
Engage with supplier and community sustainability initiatives
